title: Migrante: Rescue Filipinos allegedly recruited into Russian military

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Migrant workers’ group Migrante International on Saturday criticized the Marcos administration over its alleged failure to rescue Filipinos recruited for supposed civilian jobs in Russia but later forced into military service amid the country’s war with Ukraine. The group’s statement came after a video showing about 30 Filipinos wearing Russian military uniforms circulating on social media, with the men appealing to the Philippine government to rescue them from the war-torn country. According to Migrante, the Filipinos said they were recruited online for cleaning and construction jobs in Russia but were instead made to undergo basic military training and […]...
